sample: The tracked file keeps one row in 64 of the 331,312 the query returns, in catalogue order (sorted by right ascension). Presentation choice: enough stars for the 100 pc level of the Milky Way's dots.
meaning: Every star of the Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars (Gaia Collaboration, Smart et al. 2021), each at its median distance (Dist50): the census of stars within 100 pc of the Sun.
